title: Commercialism and contemporaries Lyttelton and Barber
summary: Colyer says no one has improved on the New Orleans pattern; he is negative about Lyttelton's swing direction and Barber's drift to arranged music.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
